0: TOWN OF VERNONBURG ORDINANCE O2026-01.A Clarifying and Authorizing Franchise Fees STATE OF GEORGIA } TOWN OF VERNONBURG } AN ORDINANCE BY THE INTENDANT AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF VERNONBURG, GEORGIA, AMENDING THE CODE OF ORDINANCES OF THE TOWN OF VERNONBURG, GEORGIA, TO ADD CHAPTER 5. ADMINISTRATIVE PROVISIONS, ARTICLE 1. FRANCHISE FEES; TO PROVIDE FOR NOTICE; TO PROVIDE FOR SEVERABILITY; TO PROVIDE AN EFFECTIVE DATE; TO REPEAL ALL ORDINANCE AND PARTS OF ORDINANCES IN CONFLICT HEREWITH; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES. WHEREAS, the duly elected governing authority of the Town of Vernonburg, Georgia, is authorized by O.C.G.A. § 36-35-3 to adopt ordinances relating to its property, affairs, and local government; and WHEREAS, the Intendant and Council have the authority to amend the Town's ordinances from time to time and where necessary to maintain adequate regulations; NOW THEREFORE, THE INTENDANT AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF VERNONBURG, GEORGIA, HEREBY ORDAIN, that the Code of Ordinances of the Town of Vernonburg, Georgia, is hereby amended by adding Chapter 5 – Administrative Provisions, Article 1 – Franchise Fees, which reads as follows: I.
3: The purpose of this Chapter is to clarify the Town’s authority to receive franchise fees from utilities and service providers, to codify existing franchise fee practices, and to authorize the imposition of franchise fees where no current franchise agreement or ordinance provision exists. Such fees are in lieu of other local taxes, fees, and assessments except where expressly provided. This Chapter is enacted under the authority of the Georgia Constitution and applicable state law, including but not limited to O.C.G.A. § 36-34-2(7) and O.C.G.A. § 36-76-6.

2 Gross Receipts means the total revenue derived from sales or charges for services within the municipal limits, excluding amounts specifically excluded by state or federal law. Franchisee means any utility or service provider granted a franchise by the Town, including electric, gas, cable television, telecommunications, or other utility services. Town means the Town of Vernonburg, Georgia.
5: Nothing in this Chapter shall be construed to alter, amend, or impair any existing franchise agreement, license, or lawful franchise fee currently in effect between the Town and any franchisee.
6: All franchise fees currently being charged and collected by the Town pursuant to ordinance, resolution, or franchise agreement are hereby recognized and ratified.
7: For any franchisee operating within the Town for which no franchise agreement or specific franchise fee is currently in effect, the Town is authorized to require a franchise fee as compensation for the use of public streets, rights-of-way, or other public property, subject to applicable state and federal law.
8:
- (a) No franchise fee shall be imposed or collected in excess of the maximum amount permitted by applicable state or federal law. (b) The Town is authorized to charge franchise fees in any amount permitted by applicable state and federal law, up to the maximum amount allowed by law, for each class of utility or service provider. (c) Franchise fees shall be established and collected by individual franchise agreement, local ordinance, or other lawful agreement between the Town and each franchisee, and not solely by operation of this Chapter. (d) The amount of any franchise fee may vary by utility type or franchisee and shall be determined by the Intendant and Council as a matter of local policy and negotiation. (e) Nothing in this Chapter shall be construed to fix, set, or mandate a franchise fee rate for any franchisee. Docusign Envelope ID: 30A2C89C-FEA0-472F-B005-00963873274C
